risk_acceptance.scope: Frozen held-out evaluation only; no retraining, tuning, reconstruction or external comparator
basis: 840 checkpoint identities, hashes, strict reload, finite parameters and fixed 50-epoch records verified
All 720 source B0 and train/validation event identities match frozen manifests
No prohibited read or denied event observed in 718 available task streams or B0 audit
A0/A1 missing and A3 attribution uncertainty explicitly TIER_2 and sensitivity-only
Primary and sensitivity sets frozen before test payload access
risk_acceptance.limitation: Missing streams cannot prove no unobserved prohibited read; original strict criterion is not waived

training_controller.binding_limit: controller source and log order support identity but do not cryptographically prove every earlier process loaded this exact blob

unresolved_access_detail.interpretation: two missing streams plus two exact duplicate A3 rows; final A3 row has atomic commit but no authenticated process attempt ID

inherited_test_metrics_and_sampling.samples: All registered test_truth planes; all fully supported radius4 centers; plane_id lexical order, row-major center order.
inherited_test_metrics_and_sampling.context: 2D teacher-forced neighborhood classification: 80 observed true neighboring phase slots, center label excluded; NOT sparse-observation reconstruction or rollout.
inherited_test_metrics_and_sampling.selection: One shared event list per material and orientation across ALL spacing/template/training-seed/variant identities. If >100000 centers, fixed seeded uniform without replacement, sorted ordinals.
inherited_test_metrics_and_sampling.event_weights: Equal event weight within model; main summary equal source material, then equal spacing, then mean all registered orientation/template/seed conditions. No fabricated missing conditions.
inherited_test_metrics_and_sampling.ece: 15 equal-width confidence bins; bin=min(floor(confidence*15),14); weighted absolute confidence-accuracy gap.
inherited_test_metrics_and_sampling.brier: mean sum over FOUR classes squared probability-onehot difference, range0..2 (not divided by4)
inherited_test_metrics_and_sampling.undefined: precision and recall undefined denominators -> empty CSV/null; per-phase F1 zero when truth or predictions present but TP=0, null if both absent; fixed FOUR-class macro F1 treats null F1 as ZERO (no absent-class dropping). Balanced accuracy averages recalls for truth-present classes; report present class count.
inherited_test_metrics_and_sampling.difference: right minus left; negative NLL/Brier/ECE and positive accuracy/F1 favor right
inherited_test_metrics_and_sampling.uncertainty: No event bootstrap, no event p-values, no population-material CI with only two sources. Condition paired differences descriptive. Report seed SD/range conditional on fixed material/spacing/orientation/template; for exactly three registered seeds report pointwise 95% t CI (df2,critical4.30265273) for training-seed mean only. n1: CI undefined. Seeds share test events. No claim of material-population significance; multiple conditional CIs exploratory, not multiplicity-adjusted.
inherited_test_metrics_and_sampling.gate: A3 diagnostics stratified by ROI, true phase and B0/A3 correctness quadrant; descriptive Pearson correlations with entropy/margin/support; no causal interpretation.
limitations: Python IO audit only; direct native syscall coverage not established for evaluation
Two source volumes; ROIs and orientations are correlated views, not independent materials

tier_definitions.TIER_1: Model, training identity and task-bound original access evidence verifiable; no observed prohibited event
tier_definitions.TIER_2: Model/training identity verifiable but original per-file access missing or attempt attribution incomplete; no direct violation observed
tier_definitions.TIER_3: Substantive model, input identity or data-source conflict; excluded from both sets
